title: Chapter close — Quantum Observable Universes
html: The Quantum Observable Universe chapter concludes. The substrate parameter q controls the differentials, the Reeb derivation \xi guides the gauge group \mathrm{SU}_q(2), and the q-special functions provide the spectral pairing. The next chapter builds the brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0}, inheriting this QOU foundation.
